name: What is the typical timeline for a custom home build or major renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a custom home build or major renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom home build or major renovation varies significantly based on project complexity, size, and material choices. A typical custom home can take anywhere from 10 to 18 months, encompassing design, permitting, and construction. Major renovations, such as a whole-house remodel or a significant addition, might range from 4 to 12 months. Factors like unforeseen site conditions, changes requested during construction, and permit approval times can also influence the overall duration. We provide a detailed project schedule early in the process and communicate updates regularly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines vary; a custom home typically takes 10-18 months, while major renovations can range from 4-12 months. Project specifics, design complexity, and permitting influence duration.
